hold_reason: review: Alibaba: A Zero-Order Hold (ZOH) is a mathematical model/circuit that holds the last sampled value constant until the next sample. It is not a 'method to convert digital to analog' in the general sense of a DAC process, but a specific component/model within that process. The description is slightly imprecise.
